knowledge:
- key_parameters: gt_matrix=The genotype matrix of progeny samples to be corrected ;; ref=Vector of reference alleles for the parents ;; alt=Vector of alternative alleles for the parents ;; fail=Character string specifying the genotype label to be treated as failed/missing (converted to NA) ;; wrong_label=Character string specifying wrong genotype labels to be converted to NA ;; min_markers=Minimum number of markers a sample must have to be retained during filtering ;; min_samples=Minimum number of samples a marker must be genotyped in to be retained ;; threshold=The percentage threshold of identical genotypes above which samples are considered duplicates ;; mapping_fun=The mapping function to calculate genetic distance, either "k" (Kosambi) or "h" (Haldane) ;; bin_size=The physical genomic interval size (in base pairs) to calculate genetic distances for equally sized bins ;; group_by=The column name in colData used to group samples for group-specific genetic distance calculation ;; minSNP=Minimum number of SNPs supporting a Viterbi segment to filter low-confidence crossovers ;; minlogllRatio=Minimum log-likelihood ratio of a Viterbi segment to filter low-confidence crossovers ;; bpDist=Minimum physical distance in base pairs to filter low-confidence crossovers ;; maxRawCO=Maximum raw crossover count allowed per chromosome to filter out outlier cells ;; minCellSNP=Minimum number of SNPs genotyped in a cell to keep the cell ;; B=The number of bootstrap or permutation replicates for group difference testing
- alternatives: sscocaller is the command-line tool used upstream to generate the sparse matrix and haplotype state files that comapr parses for single-sperm analysis.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have marker genotyping data from a progeny population (e.g., backcross) or single-cell sperm DNA sequencing haplotype data, and you want to identify crossover locations, construct genetic maps, and statistically compare recombination landscapes between individuals or experimental groups.
- pitfalls: Genotypes labeled as "Fail" or wrong labels are converted to NA, which can lead to missing values; samples or markers with high missing rates should be filtered out. Duplicate samples sharing identical genotypes across markers must be identified and removed to prevent downstream bias. Crossover counts can be non-integers because crossovers that cannot be resolved to a single marker interval are distributed proportionally to adjacent intervals based on physical size. Bootstrap calculations for group differences can produce NaNs if recombination rates are out of bounds for the mapping function.

workflows.name: marker_genotype_analysis
workflows.intent: Detect crossovers and calculate genetic distances from marker genotyping results of a progeny population.
input: parental_alleles.csv (reference and alternative alleles of the parents)
workflows.stages: 1. Correct and format genotypes using correctGT ;; 2. Count genotypes per marker and sample using countGT ;; 3. Filter out low-quality markers and samples using filterGT ;; 4. Identify and remove duplicate samples using findDupSamples ;; 5. Count crossovers across marker intervals using countCOs ;; 6. Calculate genetic distances for marker intervals or equally sized bins using calGeneticDist ;; 7. Plot genetic distances and cumulative distances using plotGeneticDist and plotWholeGenome
workflows.code:
corrected_geno <- correctGT(gt_matrix = mcols(snp_geno_gr),
                            ref = parents_geno$ref,
                            alt = parents_geno$alt,
                            fail = "Fail",
                            wrong_label = "Homo_ref")

mcols(snp_geno_gr) <- corrected_geno

genotype_counts <- countGT(mcols(snp_geno_gr))

corrected_geno <- filterGT(snp_geno_gr,
                           min_markers = 30,
                           min_samples = 2)

dups <- findDupSamples(mcols(corrected_geno),
                       threshold = 0.99)

mcols(corrected_geno) <- mcols(corrected_geno)[,colnames(mcols(corrected_geno))!="X98"]

marker_gr_cos <- countCOs(corrected_geno)

dist_gr <- calGeneticDist(marker_gr_cos,
                          mapping_fun = "k")

dist_bin_gr <- calGeneticDist(marker_gr_cos,bin_size = 1e6)

plotGeneticDist(dist_bin_gr,chr = "1")

plotGeneticDist(dist_bin_gr,chr=c("1"),cumulative = TRUE)

plotGeneticDist(dist_bin_gr,cumulative = TRUE)

plotWholeGenome(dist_bin_gr)

workflows.name: single_sperm_co_analysis
workflows.intent: Build individualized genetic maps and analyze crossovers from single-sperm haplotype state files generated by sscocaller.
input: sample_chr_vi.mtx (sparse matrix of Viterbi haplotype states)
workflows.stages: 1. Perform quality control on cells and chromosomes using perCellChrQC ;; 2. Read and parse haplotype states while filtering low-confidence crossovers using readHapState ;; 3. Combine haplotype states from multiple samples using combineHapState ;; 4. Count crossovers for SNP intervals using countCOs ;; 5. Calculate overall or group-specific genetic distances using calGeneticDist ;; 6. Plot whole-genome or chromosome-specific genetic distances using plotWholeGenome and plotGeneticDist ;; 7. Test for statistical differences between groups using bootstrapDist or permuteDist
workflows.code:
pcQC <- perCellChrQC(sampleName="s1",chroms=c("chr1"),
                     path=paste0(demo_path,"/"),
                     barcodeFile=NULL)

s1_rse_state <- readHapState("s1",chroms=c("chr1","chr2"),
                             path=demo_path,barcodeFile=NULL,
                             minSNP = 0,
                             minlogllRatio = 50,
                             bpDist = 100,
                             maxRawCO=10,
                             minCellSNP = 1)

s2_rse_state <- readHapState("s2",chroms=c("chr1","chr2"),
                             path=demo_path,
                             barcodeFile=NULL,
                             minSNP = 0,
                             minlogllRatio = 50,
                             bpDist = 100,
                             maxRawCO=10,
                             minCellSNP = 1)

colData(s1_rse_state)$sampleGroup <- "s1"

colData(s2_rse_state)$sampleGroup <- "s2"

twoSample <- combineHapState(s1_rse_state,
                             s2_rse_state)

cocounts <- countCOs(twoSample)

dist_gr <- calGeneticDist(co_count = cocounts, mapping_fun = "k")

dist_gr <- calGeneticDist(co_count = cocounts,
                          group_by  = "sampleGroup",
                          mapping_fun = "k")

p_gr <- granges(dist_gr)
mcols(p_gr) <- rowData(dist_gr)$kosambi

plotWholeGenome(p_gr)

plotGeneticDist(p_gr,chr = "chr1",cumulative = TRUE)

set.seed(100)
bootsDiff <- bootstrapDist(co_gr = cocounts,B=10,
                           group_by = "sampleGroup")

set.seed(100)
perms <- permuteDist(cocounts,B=1000,group_by = "sampleGroup")
